review_candidates.title: Senior C++ Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior C++ Software Engineer - Fully Remote (Ireland) Pure Greenfield Projects Rapid Career Growth & Progression Fully Flexible & Remote (Ireland-Based) Join an established, fast-growing global fintech company operating in the booming, fast-paced payments sector. The company’s core mission is financial access: building secure payment systems that deliver essential financial services to underprivileged and underbanked populations around the world. This role combines real technical impact with complete project ownership, high visibility, and a strong, supportive team dynamic. Because the core engineering group is small and agile, your work will be seen, your voice will be heard, and your path for fast-tracked career progression is clear as the business continues its rapid global expansion. What You Will Do Take Ownership: Lead backend software projects end-to-end from initial technical design straight through to launch. Build Payment Systems: Design, build, and maintain low-latency, high-throughput systems powering international payment rails. Ship Greenfield Code: Develop brand-new features and components using C++, Golang, PHP, and HTML. Collaborate: Work closely with software developers, support teams, and external client partners to solve complex engineering challenges. What You Need 6+ years of hands-on C++ software development experience in production environments. Strong background in multi-threaded programming , high-concurrency architecture, and REST API design . Solid experience working with relational databases and writing efficient, performance-tuned SQL . The Offer Salary: €65,000 – €75,000 + comprehensive benefits package. 100% Remote & Flexible: Complete remote work flexibility (candidates must be based in Ireland). Fast Career Progression: High visibility, direct impact, and genuine room to advance your career quickly. High-trust, low-bureaucracy culture built around delivery and technical autonomy. To hear more about the role or have a confidential chat, contact Samuel Knox on +353 1 960 9973 or email your CV directly to samuel.knox@archer.ie .

review_candidates.title: Backend and Platform Engineer (Mid level)
review_candidates.description: About us Mona AI Systems is an AI venture studio. We build AI products and companies for the Swiss market, from the first prototype to a scaled product. Our engineering team works from the centre of Prishtina (Pejton) and directly with clients in Switzerland on AI systems that process real customer requests for enterprise customers. Data protection, auditability and human approval are part of every design. We are a small team led by a senior engineer. Every engineer uses AI coding tools in daily work and ships to production early. The role You will own the platform that our AI products run on: Swiss and EU hosting, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, the multi tenant data model with client isolation at database level proven by automated tests, email ingestion with threading, the immutable audit log, data deletion jobs and observability. You make sure a mistake cannot turn into a data protection incident, and you get the penetration test findings fixed before go live. What you will do • Set up and run hosting in Swiss and EU regions: infrastructure as code, environments (dev, stage, prod), secrets, backups • Design the multi tenant data model and enforce client isolation at database level (row level security) with automated isolation tests in CI • Build the email ingestion pipeline: mailbox integration, threading, deduplication, attachment handling • Implement the immutable audit log, data retention and deletion jobs, and role based access • Own CI/CD, observability (logs, traces, error tracking, alerting) and runbooks • Work with the external penetration test and data protection review, and fix what they find What you bring • 2 to 3 years of backend engineering in production (TypeScript and Node, or Python) with PostgreSQL • Hands on infrastructure experience: Docker, infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar), a major cloud or a European provider, CI/CD pipelines • You have designed schemas and access controls and can explain the failure modes of each • Security mindset: least privilege, encryption, secrets handling, auditability • You use AI coding tools daily, review their output critically and write tests for what matters • Good written and spoken English Nice to have • Experience with multi tenant SaaS and row level security in PostgreSQL • Experience with email APIs (Microsoft Graph, Gmail, IMAP) at scale • Exposure to ISO 27001 or similar security frameworks What we offer • Competitive salary • 13th salary • Performance bonus tied to product launch and market acceptance • MacBook Pro, monitor and full set of peripherals • Paid subscriptions to AI coding tools for daily use • Personal development budget of EUR 1,200 per year: online courses, books, a vendor certification, meetup fees. You choose, the lead approves • Structured team training: cloud and AI certification tracks and one instructor led course per year • Industry events: two EU trade fairs or conferences per year, with 2 or 3 team members attending each. Travel and per diem covered • Hybrid work: 3 days from home, 2 days in our office in the centre of Prishtina (Pejton) • Quarterly team events Details • Start date: 9 November 2026 or 16 November 2026, depending on your availability • Location: Prishtina, Kosovo. Office in the city centre (Pejton). Hybrid, 3 days remote and 2 days in the office • Employment: full time • Working language: English How to apply Apply with your CV and, if you have one, a link to code or a project you are proud of. Process: a short intro call, a small practical task done with AI tooling (we look at how you prompt, verify and decide), and a conversation with the Lead AI Engineer. We aim to decide within a week.

review_candidates.title: Web Developer Intern in India
review_candidates.description: About MM(DU) Mullana Maharishi Markandeshwar (Deemed to be University), Mullana (MMDU) is a prestigious NAAC ‘A’ Grade university in North India, recognized for academic excellence and global standards. Established in 1993 near Ambala, Haryana, it offers top programs in medicine, engineering, management, law, nursing, and allied sciences on a modern, hi-tech campus. MMDU proudly hosts students from 50+ countries, creating a diverse and multicultural learning environment. With industry-focused curricula, experienced faculty, strong research exposure, and excellent placement support, the university prepares students for successful global careers. Safe accommodation, vibrant campus life, and dedicated international student services make MMDU an ideal destination for students worldwide. Role As a Web Developer Intern, you will assist the technical team in developing, maintaining, and improving the university’s web platforms and digital interfaces. The role involves working on website development tasks, supporting front-end and basic back-end functionality, and ensuring that web pages are responsive and user-friendly. This internship provides practical exposure to web technologies and development practices while allowing students to apply their programming knowledge in a real working environment. Responsibilities Assist in developing and updating web pages using basic front-end technologies. Support the maintenance and improvement of existing university websites. Help implement responsive design and user-friendly interfaces. Assist in testing, debugging, and fixing minor website issues. Support documentation and organization of website content and development processes Accommodation A place to stay will be provided and paid for. Food 3 meals per day will be provided and paid for.
